seo.title: Products
seo.description: Explore Inizh IoT gateways, sensors, dashboards, and custom software products.

items.name: Smart Hub
items.summary: A compact IoT gateway that connects Wi-Fi, BLE, LoRa and Zigbee devices to the cloud.
description: Smart Hub is the central nervous system for small-scale IoT deployments. It collects data from mixed sensor networks and forwards it securely to the cloud.
Designed for factories, farms, and smart buildings, it runs firmware built in-house and ships with a ready-made dashboard template.

gallery.alt: Smart Hub side view showing antenna ports

features.title: Multi-protocol
features.description: Wi-Fi, BLE, LoRa, Zigbee on one board.

features.title: Secure
features.description: TLS outbound, local encryption at rest.

features.title: Cloud-ready
features.description: MQTT and HTTP endpoints out of the box.

features.title: Remote config
features.description: Update firmware and settings over the air.

items.name: Field Monitor
items.tagline: Soil and weather sensing for farms.
items.summary: Solar-powered field sensor nodes that report soil moisture, temperature, and humidity.
description: Field Monitor helps farmers make irrigation decisions with real-time soil and weather data.
Each node is solar powered, waterproof, and sends readings every fifteen minutes over LoRa to a Smart Hub gateway.

image.alt: Field Monitor sensor node in a crop row

features.title: Solar powered
features.description: Runs for months without mains power.

features.title: Field mapping
features.description: Visualise readings across plots on the dashboard.

items.name: Dash Stack
items.tagline: Custom dashboards without the setup headache.
items.summary: A white-label dashboard starter for IoT and business metrics.
description: Dash Stack gives teams a head start on internal dashboards. Connect your API, pick visualisations, and deploy.
Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Recharts. It includes auth, dark mode, role-based access, and exportable reports.

features.title: Ready-made widgets
features.description: Charts, tables, maps, and KPI cards.

features.title: API first
features.description: Connect REST, MQTT, or WebSocket data sources.

features.title: Dark mode
features.description: Polished light and dark themes included.

items.name: Connect Bridge
items.summary: A lightweight integration service that connects older equipment to modern APIs.
description: Connect Bridge reads serial, Modbus, or OPC-UA data from legacy machines and exposes clean REST or MQTT interfaces.
It is deployed as a Docker container at the edge and includes a rules engine for alerts and data transformation.

features.title: Edge deployable
features.description: Runs in Docker on ARM and x86.

features.title: Rule engine
features.description: Trigger alerts and actions on incoming data.
